tpms.when: 2010 (U.S. models; no driver reset, the light clears itself)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive at 20 mph or more. The system does not re-check the pressures until the car is moving at that speed.
If all tires are now properly inflated, the light should go out a few minutes later. There is no reset button.
tpms.note: If the light blinks for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault that no reset will clear; have a Subaru dealer check it. The same happens if a wheel is fitted without its pressure sensor; a dealer has to reset the system then.
